headline: LLM agents now run multi-step omics analyses and hypothesis-verification loops
label: Llm Agents For Biology
summary: January 2026 preprints describe LLM agents that call biological tools, ML models and literature to run analyses end to end on biological data.
synthesis: The common thread is LLM-based agents that act on biological data rather than only answering questions about it. Medea runs verified multi-step analyses using biological tools, ML models and literature. PersonaAI mines 560,000 aging papers via RAG to propose hypotheses and validates them with autonomous single-cell RNA-seq analysis. BiOmics combines explicit reasoning with latent embeddings for multi-omics interpretation. MARBLE refines bioinformatics models through debate-driven architecture changes, and Deep Research maintains a persistent world state in an interactive multi-agent workflow, emphasizing iterative self-revision. What is new is the closed loop of hypothesis generation, execution and verification, most explicit in PersonaAI. Only Deep Research reports quantitative performance (48.8% open-response, 64.4% multiple-choice), so cross-item comparison is not possible.
